driver_source: import os,sys,subprocess,time,json; e=dict(os.environ); removed=[k for k in e if k.upper()=="PYTHONPATH"]; [e.pop(k) for k in removed]; a=[sys.executable]+sys.argv[1:]; t=time.monotonic(); p=subprocess.run(a,env=e,capture_output=True,text=True); print(json.dumps(dict(argv=a,returncode=p.returncode,stdout=p.stdout,stderr=p.stderr,seconds=time.monotonic()-t,python_version=sys.version,executable=sys.executable,pythonpath_present=any(k.upper()=="PYTHONPATH" for k in e),removed_keys=removed)))
effect: Copies environment and removes every case-insensitive PYTHONPATH key before fresh subprocess execution; does not mutate parent environment or repository configuration.
